name: Breakfall: Nuclear Winter
detailed_description:
A strategic survival game where you lead a group of survivors through a post-nuclear wasteland after a devastating catastrophe. In this strategic survival game, you fortify your shelter by day and scavenge dangerous ruins for resources by night. Your goal: keep your group alive until help arrives. Every choice matters.

Key Features:

Day-Night Cycle: By day, upgrade your shelter with craftable items. By night, search for wood, components, or medicine—but danger lurks everywhere.

Crafting System: Build tools (like crowbars), weapons, medicine, or even new workshops—like a Greenhouse for growing herbs—at various workstations to survive.

World Map & Exploration: Choose scavenging locations with varying risks. Encounter hostile survivors, traders, or those with requests that shape your plans.

Trade & Communication: Use the Communication Table to radio traders for resource trades or call for support.

Tactical Choices: Fight, sneak, or trade to avoid conflicts with rival groups. Crowbars can crack locks—or double as weapons.

Survival Management: Balance hunger, injuries, and your group’s unique skills to make the most of scarce resources.

Dive into a grim world with an intense atmosphere. Will you save your group?

short_description: A strategic survival game where you play a group of survivors fighting to stay alive in the aftermath of a nuclear disaster. Expand your shelter during the day and try to find supplies at night to ensure your survival.
supported_languages: English, German, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Russian

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit (or newer)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400, AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1080, AMD Radeon RX 580
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Mouse and Keyboard required. This game currently does not support Gamepad.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit (or newer)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-13700K, AMD Ryzen 7 7800X3D
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070, AMD Radeon RX 7800 XT
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Mouse and Keyboard required. This game currently does not support Gamepad.
